issues.failure_explanation: def:01(i) defines U^ε := {x ∈ M : V(x) ≤ ε}, but every use of U^ε in the paper requires the ambient sublevel set V⁻¹([0,ε]) ∩ U. The tube U^ε_{h,α} = {x + th(f(x) − α∇V(x)) : x ∈ U^ε, t ∈ [0,1]} consists of ambient points that generically leave M for t > 0, because the feedback direction −α∇V(x) has a component normal to M (in the paper's own rigid-body example, ∇_R V contains the term k₂(π−π_I)(IΩ)^T, which is not of the form R·(skew-symmetric), so the Euler update R + h(RΩ̂ − α∇_R V) leaves SO(3)). Hence U^ε_{h,α} ⊄ U^ε ⊆ M, and thm:optimal_a's clause 'U^ε_{h,β/h} ⊆ U^ε' is literally false as stated (and the 'Moreover' clause's feasible set of gains α guaranteeing this inclusion is empty). In addition, thm:optimal_a's proof applies the Łojasiewicz inequality to the ambient iterates x_k and invokes compactness of U^ε, which is not guaranteed for a general (non-closed) manifold M. All proofs in fact go through only with the ambient sublevel set, which is compact by (A2).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redefine def:01(i) as U^ε := {x ∈ U : V(x) ≤ ε} (equivalently V⁻¹([0,ε]) ∩ U). Then U^ε is compact by (A2), the tube lies in the ambient sublevel set for the step sizes established in the proofs, the Łojasiewicz inequality applies to the iterates, and the statements and proofs of thm:optimal_a, thm:adaptive_a, and thm:adaptive_a_period are all valid without further modification.
issues.overall_effect: Under the literal definition, the first clause of thm:optimal_a ('U^ε_{h,β/h} ⊆ U^ε') is false and its 'Moreover' clause is vacuous; the proof's compactness and Hessian-bound justifications on ambient segments are unjustified as written. The positive-invariance conclusions of thm:pos_invariance, the second clause of thm:optimal_a, thm:adaptive_a, and thm:adaptive_a_period are unaffected, since all of those arguments actually use the ambient sublevel set.
issues.title: U^ε is defined as a subset of the manifold M, incompatible with the ambient tube construction and with all its uses
issues.why_classification: The repair is a one-line redefinition of U^ε to the ambient sublevel set that every proof in the paper already implicitly uses; it preserves all substantive claims, guarantees, rates, and the advertised scope, and requires no new lemma, construction, or reoptimization. The defect is local to def:01(i) and to the literal reading of statements that use U^ε.
